card.meaning: A dishonest or dishonourable person.
card.example: That scoundrel sold the same horse three times.
card.exampleCa: Aquell brètol va vendre el mateix cavall tres vegades.

context.text: Even such a scoundrel as this is not deserving of murder.
context.catalan: Fins i tot un brètol com aquest no mereix que el matin.

card.meaning: In a very bad or unhappy condition.
card.example: The wretched prisoners had not eaten for days.
card.exampleCa: Els desgraciats presoners feia dies que no menjaven.

context.text: What could you ever hope to learn from a wretched fool like me?
context.catalan: Què podries esperar aprendre mai d’un ximple miserable com jo?

card.meaning: An archaic singular subject pronoun meaning you.
card.example: Thou hast broken the oath of this order.
card.exampleCa: Has trencat el jurament d'aquest orde.

context.text: I have no doubt thou shalt make an interesting traveling companion.
context.catalan: No tinc cap dubte que seràs un company de viatge interessant.

card.meaning: An archaic singular object pronoun meaning you.
card.example: I give thee my word that I shall return.
card.exampleCa: Et dono la meva paraula que tornaré.

context.text: 'Twas beauty in that, but I cannot be confined with thee.
context.catalan: Hi havia bellesa en això, però no puc quedar-me tancat amb tu.

card.meaning: An enemy, especially in literary or fantasy language.
card.example: Even a wounded foe can still be dangerous.
card.exampleCa: Fins i tot un enemic ferit pot continuar sent perillós.

context.text: What kind of simpleton attacks a foe he does not know!
context.catalan: Quina mena de ximple ataca un enemic que no coneix!

card.meaning: To pay close attention to advice or a warning.
card.example: Heed my warning and stay away from the well.
card.exampleCa: Fes cas del meu advertiment i allunya't del pou.

context.text: I will heed your warnings, but I must still go on.
context.catalan: Faré cas dels teus advertiments, però tot i així he de continuar.

card.catalan: no fos cas que; per por que
card.meaning: In order to prevent something undesirable from happening.
card.example: Speak softly, lest you wake the guards.
card.exampleCa: Parla fluix, no fos cas que despertessis els guàrdies.

context.text: Leave now, lest you earn the same fate that they have!
context.catalan: Marxeu ara, no fos cas que patiu la mateixa sort que ells!

card.meaning: To break someone's trust or hand them to an enemy.
card.example: She would never betray the people who sheltered her.
card.exampleCa: No trairia mai la gent que l'havia acollida.

context.text: Why the hell did you betray him in the first place?
context.catalan: Per què dimonis el vas trair, per començar?

card.meaning: A lasting feeling of resentment about a past wrong.
card.example: Dwarves in this story could hold a grudge for centuries.
card.exampleCa: Els nans d'aquesta història podien guardar rancúnia durant segles.

context.text: I bear all of your type a grudge.
context.catalan: Guardo rancúnia a tots els de la teva mena.

card.meaning: A surprise attack from a concealed position.
card.example: The overturned cart was the perfect place for an ambush.
card.exampleCa: El carro bolcat era el lloc perfecte per a una emboscada.

context.text: The woman tricked me into an ambush with her sorry tale!
context.catalan: La dona em va enganyar amb la seva història llastimosa i em va fer caure en una emboscada!

card.meaning: A difficult or dangerous situation someone is in.
card.example: The refugees begged us to understand their plight.
card.exampleCa: Els refugiats ens suplicaven que entenguéssim la seva situació penosa.

context.text: We met one of your fellows and she told us of your plight.
context.catalan: Vam conèixer una de les teves companyes i ens va explicar el vostre tràngol.

card.meaning: An old-fashioned word for a dishonest man.
card.example: You are a knave if you think I will pay twice.
card.exampleCa: Ets un bergant si et penses que pagaré dues vegades.

context.text: You'll learn respect, ye cocky knave!
context.catalan: Aprendràs a respectar, bergant arrogant!

card.meaning: To ask urgently and earnestly.
card.example: I beseech you to spare the villagers.
card.exampleCa: Et suplico que perdonis la vida als vilatans.

context.text: I beseech you, cease your attack!
context.catalan: Us suplico que atureu el vostre atac!

card.meaning: To leave someone behind or give up a commitment.
card.example: I will not forsake you in your hour of need.
card.exampleCa: No t'abandonaré quan més em necessitis.

context.text: Many will seek the power you forsake!
context.catalan: Molts buscaran el poder al qual renuncies!

card.meaning: Betrayal of someone's trust.
card.example: The captain paid dearly for his ally's treachery.
card.exampleCa: El capità va pagar molt cara la traïció del seu aliat.

context.text: That is good, but you must remain alert to any treachery.
context.catalan: Això està bé, però has de mantenir-te alerta davant de qualsevol traïció.

card.meaning: Great sorrow or trouble, common in literary speech.
card.example: Woe to anyone who breaks the ancient seal.
card.exampleCa: Ai de qui trenqui l'antic segell.

context.text: Woe to the fool who gets in the way of my fun tonight!
context.catalan: Ai del ximple que s’interposi en la meva diversió aquesta nit!

card.meaning: To charm or deceive someone into doing something.
card.example: The stranger tried to beguile us with promises of gold.
card.exampleCa: El desconegut ens intentava entabanar amb promeses d'or.

context.text: You can't beguile me with polite words, Red Wizard.
context.catalan: No em pots entabanar amb paraules corteses, Mag Roig.

card.meaning: A literary verb meaning to kill.
card.example: They vowed to slay the beast before winter.
card.exampleCa: Van jurar matar la bèstia abans de l'hivern.

context.text: He wanted me to slay a witch named Dynaheir, but I declined.
context.catalan: Volia que matés una bruixa anomenada Dynaheir, però m’hi vaig negar.

card.meaning: The den or dwelling of a dangerous creature.
card.example: We found the beast's lair behind the waterfall.
card.exampleCa: Vam trobar el cau de la bèstia darrere la cascada.

context.text: She asks that we destroy the wolf beasts in their lair.
context.catalan: Ens demana que destruïm les bèsties llop al seu cau.

card.meaning: A container for arrows; as a verb, to tremble.
card.example: She reached for the last arrow in her quiver.
card.exampleCa: Va allargar la mà cap a l'última fletxa del buirac.

context.text: Usually made of leather, a quiver can hold anywhere from 20 to 40 arrows or crossbow bolts.
context.catalan: Normalment fet de cuir, un buirac pot contenir entre 20 i 40 fletxes o cairons de ballesta.

card.meaning: An old-fashioned command or verb meaning to look at.
card.example: Behold the crown of the fallen king.
card.exampleCa: Contempla la corona del rei caigut.

context.text: Behold the mystical marvel that is my grandfather's flail.
context.catalan: Contempla la meravella mística que és el flagell d’armes del meu avi.

card.meaning: A very cowardly person, or behaving without courage.
card.example: The craven guard fled before the fighting began.
card.exampleCa: El guàrdia covard va fugir abans que comencés la lluita.

context.text: You are no blood of mine, you foot-licking craven!
context.catalan: No ets de la meva sang, covard llepaculs!

card.meaning: To steal goods by force, especially during war.
card.example: The raiders returned to plunder the village.
card.exampleCa: Els assaltants van tornar per saquejar el poble.

context.text: You will spy the road while Rededge an' I plunder within.
context.catalan: Tu vigilaràs el camí mentre en Rededge i jo saquegem a dins.

card.meaning: An old-fashioned word meaning not one or no.
card.example: Nary an eve goes by without us losing another hand to the night.
card.exampleCa: No passa ni un vespre sense que perdem un altre treballador a mans de la nit.

context.text: Nary an eve goes by without us losing another hand to the night.
context.catalan: No passa ni un vespre sense que perdem un altre treballador a mans de la nit.

card.meaning: An archaic form of have used with thou.
card.example: Hast thou come to collect the inheritance from your father?
card.exampleCa: Has vingut a recollir l’herència del teu pare?

context.text: Hast thou come to collect the inheritance from your father?
context.catalan: Has vingut a recollir l’herència del teu pare?

card.meaning: An archaic form of shall used with thou.
card.example: I have no doubt thou shalt make an interesting traveling companion.
card.exampleCa: No tinc cap dubte que seràs un company de viatge interessant.

context.text: I have no doubt thou shalt make an interesting traveling companion.
context.catalan: No tinc cap dubte que seràs un company de viatge interessant.

card.meaning: An old-fashioned insult for a dishonest or contemptible person.
card.example: Unlike the others, I know just what a blackguard I face.
card.exampleCa: A diferència dels altres, sé perfectament a quin malvat m’enfronto.

context.text: Unlike the others, I know just what a blackguard I face.
context.catalan: A diferència dels altres, sé perfectament a quin malvat m’enfronto.

card.meaning: To consider something worthy of doing, often reluctantly.
card.example: But no, they would not deign to be so human.
card.exampleCa: Però no, no es dignarien a ser tan humans.

context.text: But no, they would not deign to be so human.
context.catalan: Però no, no es dignarien a ser tan humans.

card.meaning: An old-fashioned or literary word meaning no.
card.example: Nay, you not only seek them, you expect them!
card.exampleCa: No, no només els busques, sinó que els esperes!

context.text: Nay, you not only seek them, you expect them!
context.catalan: No, no només els busques, sinó que els esperes!
